FunctionBody:
CatoNetworksEvents_CL
| where not(disabled)
| where tostring(column_ifexists('event_type', '')) == 'Security'
| where tostring(column_ifexists('event_sub_type', '')) in ('Internet Firewall', 'WAN Firewall', 'LAN Firewall', 'IPS', 'Suspicious Activity', 'Dynamic Prevention', 'DNS Protection')
// Sentinel's DCR maps source epoch-millisecond time into native TimeGenerated.
// A retained original time takes precedence; time_str is only an alternative source clock.
| where tostring(column_ifexists("event_sub_type", "")) != "Flow"
| where tostring(column_ifexists("source", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
    and tostring(column_ifexists("sourcetype", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
    and tostring(column_ifexists("Type", "")) != "cato:hec:flows"
| extend _CatoCommonRawCount = column_ifexists("event_count", dynamic(null)),
    _CatoCommonEpoch = tostring(column_ifexists("time", dynamic(null))),
    _CatoCommonTimeStr = tostring(column_ifexists("time_str", "")),
    _CatoCommonMappedTime = todatetime(column_ifexists("TimeGenerated", datetime(null))),
    _CatoCommonExtra = todynamic(column_ifexists("AdditionalFields", "{}"))
| extend _CatoCommonCountText = tostring(_CatoCommonRawCount),
    _CatoCommonCount = tolong(_CatoCommonRawCount),
    _CatoCommonPrimaryTime = iff(isempty(_CatoCommonEpoch), _CatoCommonMappedTime,
        iff(_CatoCommonEpoch matches regex @"^-?[0-9]+$", unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(_CatoCommonEpoch)), datetime(null))),
    _CatoCommonAlternativeTime = iff(_CatoCommonTimeStr matches regex @"^-?[0-9]+$",
        unixtime_milliseconds_todatetime(tolong(_CatoCommonTimeStr)), todatetime(_CatoCommonTimeStr))
| where isnull(_CatoCommonRawCount)
    or (_CatoCommonCountText matches regex @"^[0-9]+$" and _CatoCommonCount between (1 .. 2147483647))
| extend _CatoCommonSourceTime = coalesce(_CatoCommonPrimaryTime, _CatoCommonAlternativeTime)
| where isnotnull(_CatoCommonSourceTime)
| where (isnull(starttime) or _CatoCommonSourceTime >= starttime)
    and (isnull(endtime) or _CatoCommonSourceTime <= endtime)
| extend
    TimeGenerated = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventStartTime = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventEndTime = _CatoCommonSourceTime,
    EventCount = toint(coalesce(_CatoCommonCount, long(1))),
    EventVendor = "Cato Networks",
    EventProduct = "Cato Cloud",
    EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
    EventOriginalType = tostring(column_ifexists("event_type", "")),
    EventOriginalSubType = tostring(column_ifexists("event_sub_type", "")),
    EventOriginalUid = tostring(column_ifexists("event_id", "")),
    EventUid = tostring(column_ifexists("event_id", "")),
    EventMessage = tostring(column_ifexists("event_message", "")),
    AdditionalFields = iff(gettype(_CatoCommonExtra) == "dictionary", _CatoCommonExtra, dynamic({})),
    Dvc = "Cato Cloud",
    DvcOriginalAction = tostring(column_ifexists("action", "")),
    DvcScopeId = tostring(column_ifexists("account_id", "")),
    DvcScope = tostring(column_ifexists("account_name", ""))
| extend AdditionalFields = bag_merge(AdditionalFields, iff(isempty(tostring(column_ifexists("pop_name", ""))),
    dynamic({}), bag_pack("CatoPopName", tostring(column_ifexists("pop_name", "")))))
| project-away _CatoCommon*
| extend _CatoSubtype = tostring(column_ifexists('event_sub_type', ''))
| extend EventSchema = 'NetworkSession', EventType = iff(_CatoSubtype in ('Internet Firewall', 'WAN Firewall', 'LAN Firewall'), 'NetworkSession', 'IDS'),
    _CatoFirewall = _CatoSubtype in ('Internet Firewall', 'WAN Firewall', 'LAN Firewall'),
    _CatoRoutedFirewall = _CatoSubtype in ('Internet Firewall', 'WAN Firewall'),
    _CatoSrcIp = tostring(column_ifexists('src_ip', '')), _CatoDstIp = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_ip', '')),
    _CatoSrcNatIp = tostring(column_ifexists('translated_client_ip', '')), _CatoDstNatIp = tostring(column_ifexists('translated_server_ip', '')),
    _CatoSrcPort = toint(column_ifexists('src_port', '')), _CatoDstPort = toint(column_ifexists('dest_port', '')),
    _CatoProtocol = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('ip_protocol', ''))), _CatoAction = tolower(tostring(column_ifexists('action', ''))),
    _CatoUser = tostring(column_ifexists('user_name', '')), _CatoSrcHost = tostring(column_ifexists('configured_host_name', '')),
    _CatoDirection = toupper(tostring(column_ifexists('traffic_direction', ''))),
    _CatoAppStack = parse_json(tostring(column_ifexists('app_stack', ''))),
    _CatoSrcVlan = tostring(column_ifexists('client_vlan', '')), _CatoDstVlan = tostring(column_ifexists('server_vlan', '')),
    _CatoMac = tostring(column_ifexists('host_mac', '')), _CatoDeviceType = tostring(column_ifexists('device_type', ''))
// IANA snapshot 2026-10-29: https://www.iana.org/assignments/protocol-numbers/protocol-numbers-1.csv

// Dictionary scopes apply to inherited fields as well as firewall fields.
// Firewall Monitor is an allowed rule decision; an IDS Monitor is not.
| extend SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoSrcIp)) and _CatoSrcIp !contains '/', _CatoSrcIp, ''), DstIpAddr = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoDstIp)) and _CatoDstIp !contains '/', _CatoDstIp, ''),
    SrcNatIpAddr = iff(_CatoRoutedFirewall and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoSrcNatIp)) and _CatoSrcNatIp !contains '/', _CatoSrcNatIp, ''),
    DstNatIpAddr = iff(_CatoRoutedFirewall and isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoDstNatIp)) and _CatoDstNatIp !contains '/', _CatoDstNatIp, ''),
    SrcPortNumber = iff(_CatoSrcPort between (0 .. 65535), _CatoSrcPort, int(null)), DstPortNumber = iff(_CatoDstPort between (0 .. 65535), _CatoDstPort, int(null)),
    NetworkProtocol = coalesce(tostring(_CatoProtocolCodeNames[tostring(toint(_CatoProtocol))]), tostring(_CatoProtocolNameNames[_CatoProtocol])),
    NetworkDirection = case(_CatoSubtype == 'LAN Firewall', '', _CatoDirection == 'INBOUND', 'Inbound', _CatoDirection == 'OUTBOUND', 'Outbound', _CatoDirection == 'WANBOUND', 'Local', _CatoDirection == 'NO_DIRECTION', 'NA', ''),
    DvcOriginalAction = tostring(column_ifexists('action', '')),
    DvcAction = case(_CatoAction in ('allow', 'allowed') or (_CatoFirewall and _CatoAction == 'monitor'), 'Allow', _CatoAction in ('block', 'blocked', 'deny', 'denied'), 'Deny', _CatoAction == 'drop', 'Drop', _CatoAction == 'drop icmp', 'Drop ICMP', _CatoAction == 'reset', 'Reset', _CatoAction == 'reset source', 'Reset Source', _CatoAction == 'reset destination', 'Reset Destination', _CatoAction == 'encrypt', 'Encrypt', _CatoAction == 'decrypt', 'Decrypt', _CatoAction == 'vpnroute', 'VPNroute', ''),
    SrcUsername = iff(_CatoUser matches regex @'^([^\s@\\]+@[^\s@\\]+|[^\s@\\]+\\[^\s@\\]+|[^\s@\\]+)$', _CatoUser, ''),
    DstAppName = tostring(column_ifexists('application_name', '')), DstAppId = tostring(column_ifexists('application_id', '')),
    NetworkSessionId = iff(_CatoSubtype != 'LAN Firewall', tostring(column_ifexists('flow_id', '')), ''),
    NetworkApplicationProtocol = case(gettype(_CatoAppStack) != 'array', '', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'HTTP(S)'), 'HTTP(S)', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'DNS'), 'DNS', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'FTP'), 'FTP', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'SSH'), 'SSH', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'SMTP'), 'SMTP', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'TLS'), 'TLS', set_has_element(_CatoAppStack, 'QUIC'), 'QUIC', ''),
    NetworkRuleName = iff(_CatoSubtype != 'Suspicious Activity', tostring(column_ifexists('rule_name', '')), ''),
    ThreatName = iff(EventType == 'IDS', tostring(column_ifexists('threat_name', '')), ''), ThreatId = iff(EventType == 'IDS', tostring(column_ifexists('signature_id', '')), ''),
    ThreatCategory = iff(EventType == 'IDS' and _CatoSubtype != 'Dynamic Prevention', tostring(column_ifexists('threat_type', '')), ''),
    SrcZone = tostring(column_ifexists('src_site_name', '')), DstZone = iff(_CatoSubtype != 'LAN Firewall', tostring(column_ifexists('dest_site_name', '')), ''),
    SrcGeoCountry = tostring(column_ifexists('src_country', '')), DstGeoCountry = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_country', '')),
    SrcMacAddr = iff(_CatoMac matches regex @'^(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$' or _CatoMac matches regex @'^(?:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}-){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$', tolower(replace_string(_CatoMac, '-', ':')), ''),
    SrcDvcId = tostring(column_ifexists('device_id', '')),
    SrcDeviceType = case(_CatoDeviceType =~ 'Computer', 'Computer', _CatoDeviceType =~ 'Mobile Device', 'Mobile Device', _CatoDeviceType =~ 'Other', 'Other', ''),
    SrcVlanId = iff(_CatoSubtype in ('LAN Firewall', 'IPS') and _CatoSrcVlan matches regex @'^[0-9]+$' and toint(_CatoSrcVlan) between (0 .. 4094), toint(_CatoSrcVlan), int(null)),
    DstVlanId = iff(_CatoSubtype in ('LAN Firewall', 'IPS') and _CatoDstVlan matches regex @'^[0-9]+$' and toint(_CatoDstVlan) between (0 .. 4094), toint(_CatoDstVlan), int(null)),
    DstFQDN = iff(_CatoRoutedFirewall, tostring(column_ifexists('full_path_url', '')), ''), DstDomain = tostring(column_ifexists('dest_domain', ''))
| extend SrcUsernameType = iff(_CatoFirewall and isnotempty(SrcUsername), tostring(column_ifexists('src_endpoint_type', '')), ''),
    DstAppType = iff(_CatoFirewall and (isnotempty(DstAppName) or isnotempty(DstAppId)), tostring(column_ifexists('application_type', '')), ''),
    SrcDvcIdType = iff(_CatoFirewall and isnotempty(SrcDvcId), _CatoDeviceType, '')
| extend _CatoSrcDnsName = isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and isempty(parse_ipv6(_CatoSrcHost)) and _CatoSrcHost matches regex @'^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}(\.[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63})*$',
    _CatoSrcWindowsName = isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and _CatoSrcHost matches regex @'^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}\\[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}$'
| extend EventResult = case(DvcAction in ('Deny', 'Drop', 'Drop ICMP', 'Reset', 'Reset Source', 'Reset Destination'), 'Failure', isnotempty(DvcAction), 'Success', 'NA'),
    InnerVlanId = SrcVlanId, OuterVlanId = DstVlanId,
    SrcHostname = case(_CatoSrcWindowsName, tostring(split(_CatoSrcHost, '\\')[1]), _CatoSrcDnsName, tostring(split(_CatoSrcHost, '.')[0]), ''),
    SrcDomain = case(not(_CatoFirewall), '', _CatoSrcWindowsName, tostring(split(_CatoSrcHost, '\\')[0]), _CatoSrcDnsName and _CatoSrcHost contains '.', extract(@'^[^.]+\.(.+)$', 1, _CatoSrcHost), ''),
    NetworkProtocolVersion = iff((isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and isnull(parse_ipv4(SrcIpAddr))) or (isnotempty(DstIpAddr) and isnull(parse_ipv4(DstIpAddr))), 'IPv6', 'IPv4')
| extend SrcDomainType = case(isempty(SrcDomain), '', _CatoSrcWindowsName, 'Windows', 'FQDN'),
    Src = SrcIpAddr, Dst = DstIpAddr, IpAddr = SrcIpAddr, Rule = NetworkRuleName,
    _CatoSrcMatch = has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix), _CatoDstMatch = has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, ipaddr_has_any_prefix),
    _CatoSrcHostMatch = SrcHostname has_any (hostname_has_any)
| where array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(SrcIpAddr, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix)
| where array_length(dstipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or has_any_ipv4_prefix(DstIpAddr, dstipaddr_has_any_prefix)
| where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or _CatoSrcMatch or _CatoDstMatch
| where isnull(dstportnumber) or DstPortNumber == dstportnumber
| where isempty(tostring(hostname_has_any)) or tostring(hostname_has_any) == '[]' or _CatoSrcHostMatch
| where isempty(tostring(dvcaction)) or tostring(dvcaction) == '[]' or DvcAction in~ (dvcaction)
| where isempty(eventresult) or eventresult == '*' or EventResult =~ eventresult
| extend ASimMatchingIpAddr = case(array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0, '', _CatoSrcMatch and _CatoDstMatch, 'Both', _CatoSrcMatch, 'SrcIpAddr', 'DstIpAddr'),
    ASimMatchingHostname = iff(isempty(tostring(hostname_has_any)) or tostring(hostname_has_any) == '[]', '', 'SrcHostname')
| extend AdditionalFields = bag_merge(AdditionalFields, iff(_CatoSubtype in ('IPS', 'Suspicious Activity', 'Dynamic Prevention'), bag_pack('CatoUrl', tostring(column_ifexists('full_path_url', ''))), dynamic({})))
| project-away _Cato*
| extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_merge(AdditionalFields, pack_all(true)), AdditionalFields)
